input.content: Pattern: new-consumer / old-provider receipt-ack backward-compat break. A client increment starts requiring a response field the provider only emits in a *later, separate, pending* increment (e.g. `if response.get("applied") is not True: raise`). Against the current/supported provider — which does not yet return the field — `.get()` yields None and every call raises, breaking the default flow (even when a feature flag like `enhanced_settings` is off, because enforcement isn't gated on it). Violates "independently releasable main" and "ordinary saves keep working with the supported provider." Tell-tale: accompanying unit test is edited to add the new field to its stub fixture (making the test pass) instead of adding a legacy-provider test case — masking the regression. Fix: capability-negotiate or treat an absent receipt field as a legacy provider (success), only failing on an explicit negative (`applied is False`); add a test that stubs the old provider response shape.
